'''Minboosa District''' was the name of a district overseen by [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Vobbara Yusinduu]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].<ref name="Codex" />

==History==
Minboosa District stood out differently from other territories on Nal Hutta due to its relatively calm surroundings. During the [[third Galactic War]], Vobbara Yusinduu, Minboosa's crime lord, had become incredibly wealthy beyond [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] standards due to his highly lucrative [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] [[Gas/Legends|gas]] [[Refinery/Legends|refinery]].<ref name="Codex" />

While much of Nal Hutta's surface had been reduced to toxic wetlands in the [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] since the Hutts [[15,000 BBY/Legends|first plundered]] the planet, many structures in the district were predicted to sink into the [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] by the end of the [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]]. However, Yusinduu's [[Refining Factory|tibanna refinery]] was expected to remain safe.<ref name="Codex" />

During the [[Mandalorian civil war (Third Galactic War)|Mandalorian civil war]] between the [[Mandalorian Trat'ade]] and the [[Hidden Chain]], one of the Hidden Chain strike teams [[Raid on the Minboosa District|raided]] the district to capture hostages. The raiders fought against Yusinduu's [[Refinery Security Forces|security forces]] when the Hutt ordered a lockdown that prevented the raiders from fleeing the district.<ref name="OutOfTheMire">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Out of the Mire|[[Nal Hutta/Legends|Hutta]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Minboosa District first appeared in the [[2024]] Game Update 7.5 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'', the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TORweb">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20240502-0|text=Game Update 7.5 "Desperate Defiance" Recap and VOD}}</ref>
